common.name: Name
common.unexpectedError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.comingSoon: This area arrives in one of the next phases.

auth.loginIntro: Enter your e-mail address. We'll send you a sign-in link – no password needed.
auth.linkSentBody: If an approved account exists for {email}, we've sent you a sign-in link. It's valid for 15 minutes.
auth.registerIntro: Register with your name and e-mail address. An admin approves your account – afterwards you can sign in with a magic link.
auth.messagePlaceholder: Who are you, why would you like to join?
auth.registeredBody: An admin will review your request. As soon as your account is approved you'll receive an e-mail with your sign-in link.
auth.pendingBody: An admin will approve your account shortly. You'll receive an e-mail when it's ready.
auth.suspendedBody: Please contact an admin if you think this is a mistake.
auth.invalidLinkTitle: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

home.intro: This is the home of your community. Knowledge areas, meetings and messages live in the menu on the left.
home.adminHint: As an admin you can manage name, logo, colors, purpose and members under “Admin”.
home.pendingMembers: {count, plural, =0 {No pending registrations} =1 {One pending registration} other {# pending registrations}}

profile.title: My profile
profile.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, max. 5 MB. The image is cropped to a square.
profile.photoTooLarge: The image is too large (max. 5 MB).
profile.photoInvalid: Please upload a JPG, PNG or WebP image.

general.title: General & branding
general.intro: Name, logo, favicon and color scheme of the app.
general.name: Community name
general.logoHint: PNG, SVG or WebP. Shown in the left panel and on the sign-in page.
general.faviconHint: PNG or ICO, square, at least 64×64 px.
general.botNameHint: Sender of chat messages from workflows (action “Send message”).

purpose.title: Community purpose
purpose.intro: Describe what this community is for. Members see this text and it is embedded into every LLM system prompt used by workflows.
purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.placeholder: e.g. “We are a network of AI consultants sharing knowledge, experience and tools around AI adoption in mid-sized companies.”
purpose.hint: German or English – LLM instructions themselves are English, the purpose is embedded as-is.

members.title: Members
members.intro: Approve new registrations, assign roles, suspend accounts.
members.approved: {name} has been approved and notified by e-mail.
members.cannotChangeSelf: You cannot change your own account here.

knowledge.title: Knowledge areas
knowledge.intro: Areas are categories for content. Every area needs a purpose – members see it and it is embedded into LLM prompts.
knowledge.dialogIntro: Name, purpose and icon of the area.
knowledge.name: Name
knowledge.purposePlaceholder: e.g. “Collection of practical examples for AI in sales – focused on concrete outcomes.”
knowledge.purposeHint: Required. Describes what belongs into this area.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge areas yet. Create the first one.
knowledge.notEmpty: The area still contains content and cannot be deleted.

errors.nameRequired: Please enter a name (at least 2 characters).
errors.purposeRequired: Please describe the purpose (at least 5 characters).

llm.title: LLM providers
llm.intro: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenRouter, Cortecs.ai, OpenAI or your own). Enabled models become available in workflows.
llm.dialogIntro: Endpoint and API key. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
llm.name: Name
llm.empty: No provider yet. Add e.g. OpenRouter and then load the models.
llm.confirmDelete: Really delete provider “{name}”? Workflows using it will fail.
llm.enableHint: Checkbox = usable in workflows; “Default” = preselected model.
llm.manualModels: Add model ids manually (if /models is missing)

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.intro: Automations: one trigger, one or more actions. Members can read the definitions under “Workflows”.
workflows.createIntro: Pick a trigger and actions. Templates use Liquid variables such as trigger.content.url, steps.read.output.markdown or app.purpose (in double curly braces).
workflows.editIntro: Every save creates a new version (currently v{version}).
workflows.confirmDelete: Really delete workflow “{name}”? History will be lost.
workflows.runNowHint: Starts a test run with the event below (the trigger's sample payload, editable).
workflows.runNowManualHint: Starts a run with the input below (available as trigger.input).
workflows.toastAudienceHint: Who sees the toast in the top-right corner while it runs.

questions.title: Questions & surveys
questions.intro: Questions asked by workflows (action “Ask the user”) with answers and distribution.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Keys for the MCP server (e.g. Claude Code). Each key belongs to the creating admin and carries scopes.
apiKeys.dialogIntro: Name, scopes and an optional expiry.
apiKeys.createdIntro: Copy the key now – it is shown only once.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.onlyOnce: This key will never be shown again. Create a new one if lost.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke key “{name}”? Clients using it lose access immediately.
apiKeys.mcpIntro: The MCP server lets you inspect and edit workflows from Claude Code (or other MCP clients) – fields and docs are English.
apiKeys.mcpHint: Endpoint: {url} (Streamable HTTP). Auth: Authorization: Bearer API-KEY.

meetings.title: Meeting spaces
meetings.intro: Spaces where meetings, seminars or events take place. Every space needs a purpose.
meetings.dialogIntro: Name, purpose, icon and recording default.
meetings.name: Name
meetings.purposePlaceholder: e.g. “Weekly member exchange on current AI topics.”
meetings.recordingDefaultHint: Default for new audio/video meetings in this space (changeable per meeting).
meetings.empty: No meeting spaces yet. Create the first one.
meetings.notEmpty: The space still contains meetings and cannot be deleted.

errors.nameRequired: Please enter a name (at least 2 characters).
errors.purposeRequired: Please describe the purpose (at least 5 characters).

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.intro: External services used by the app.

livekit.title: LiveKit (meetings: audio/video calls & recording)
livekit.intro: The media server runs as its own service (see docs/meetings-livekit.md). Enter the connection details here.
livekit.enabledHint: Only when enabled can members create and start audio/video meetings.
livekit.urlHint: wss://meet.your-domain.com – used for browser clients and the server API.
livekit.recordingsPathHint: Path written by egress and read by the worker (mounted as the same host directory in both compose resources).
livekit.recordingDefaultHint: Global default; meeting spaces and meetings may override.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.intro: All knowledge areas at a glance.
knowledge.noAreas: There are no knowledge areas yet.
knowledge.noAreasAdminHint: Create the first area in the admin section.
knowledge.empty: No content in this area yet.

typeHints.markdown: Markdown text, e.g. a guide, note or article.
typeHints.image: Image or screenshot – upload or by URL.
typeHints.video: Upload a video or link one (YouTube, Vimeo, direct URL).
typeHints.link: External link with preview and optional note.

errors.mediaRequired: Please upload a file or provide a URL.

errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (max. {mb} MB).
errors.unsupported: This file type is not supported.

contacts.requestIntro: You can only message each other after they accept. A short note helps.
contacts.messagePlaceholder: Hi, I'd like to connect about …
contacts.accepted: Contact confirmed – you can message each other now.
contacts.confirmBlock: Really block {name}? You won't be able to message each other.

messages.emptyHint: Send a member a contact request – once accepted you can chat here.
messages.placeholder: Write a message … (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
messages.noAccess: This conversation does not exist or you are not a member.

workflows.intro: These automations run in the community. Here you can see what they do.

editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What this workflow does – understandable for members.

editor.noProviders: No LLM provider configured – add one under Admin → LLM.

meetings.intro: All meeting spaces at a glance.
meetings.noSpaces: There are no meeting spaces yet.
meetings.noSpacesAdminHint: Create the first space in the admin section.
